subject: Numbers QA + stage cleanse before board data lock
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: board-ops@boardroom.example.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Numbers QA + stage cleanse before board data lock

Team —

We lock numbers for the board packet next Friday EOD (2026-07-24). Before then I need a short, actionable cleanse pass across open pipeline and commits so the investor deck reflects bookings and ARR we can stand behind. Please run the checklist below and reply in-thread with any exceptions or blockers by EOD Wednesday (2026-07-22):

1) Stage hygiene: move any opps that haven't had activity in 30+ days to Stalled or Lost.
2) Committed deals: confirm contract signature date and revenue recognition month. If revenue is pushed, flag the impact on Q3 ARR.
3) Big-name verification: ACME / Nova / Helix — include supporting doc (PO, signed SOW).
4) Out-of-territory/partner-led deals: mark if they require marketplace listing or reseller paperwork.
5) Attach an exported CSV of updated pipeline (include HubSpot deal id) and one-line rationale for any changes.

Attachments: pipeline_export_q3.csv (please append your initials to the filename when you return it).

Why this matters: the board packet will include a bookings waterfall and ARR bridge. Any post-lock changes are high-friction for investors; we want minimal re-writes. If you see anything >$100k that might flip, alert me and Laura immediately.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:12 -0700

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Numbers QA + stage cleanse before board data lock

Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. I've done a first-pass reconciliation against HubSpot and finance. Notes below (summary first, details in the attached CSV on Drive):

- Total open pipeline value (net) before cleanse: $14.6M
- After proposed stage moves and removing duplicates: $12.9M
- Potential Q3 bookings at risk > $100k: ACME (est $420k), Helix (est $150k) — both flagged in the CSV with deal IDs.

ACME specifics: HubSpot Close Date 2026-07-28, signed SOW dated 2026-07-29 (signature date inconsistencies noted). Finance will not recognize revenue until the signature is timestamped in DocuSign; I've left ACME in Commit but added a note that it is conditional on signature confirmation.

Action items I completed:
- Moved 18 opps to Stalled with last activity > 60 days.
- Normalized currency to USD for multi-currency opps.
- Attached HubSpot link per deal in the CSV.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/board-metrics-2026 (see folder: dev-pipeline-cleanse/{your_initial}).

If nobody objects to the ACME conditional flag, I'll leave Commit status as-is but mark it in the dashboard as "Commit - Conditional" so the board narrative can call it out.

-Dev
Revenue Ops Manager

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 16:02:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Numbers QA + stage cleanse before board data lock

Thanks all — clean work.

Two small asks before I sign off on the packet:

• Dev — please add a one-line justification column to the CSV for every deal moved to Stalled/Lost (we need traceability for auditors).
• Marissa — confirm whether ACME will provide the signed DocuSign by COB Thursday (2026-07-23). If not, we'll present it as a post-lock risk item rather than Commit.

Once those two items are in, I will finalize the bookings waterfall and ARR bridge and circulate the draft to the board-ops address.

Laura Bennett
CFO (interim)
Redwood Inference
